fonts.display: 'Inter Tight', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'Inter', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Deep Teal
palette.role: Primary structural color — dark hero background, stat block surfaces, icon strokes, navigation wordmark, secondary button borders. A near-gray teal that reads as ink rather than ocean, so it grounds the brand without going clinical-cold

palette.name: Mint Pulse
palette.role: Primary action color — filled CTA backgrounds, badge fills, active dots, announcement bar, review star highlights. Bright green with cyan lean, makes every interactive element feel switched on and biological

palette.name: Soft Teal
palette.role: Teal text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

palette.name: Carbon
palette.role: Body text, hairline borders, icon strokes, input borders. The dominant structural neutral — most borders on the site are pure black, giving the UI a stark, editorial frame

palette.name: Ink
palette.role: Primary heading text and secondary borders. Softer than pure black for large headlines where Carbon reads as too heavy

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Subhead text, button text on light surfaces, muted labels

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Muted body text, helper copy, disabled labels, secondary icon strokes. The workhorse neutral for anything that needs to recede

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Input borders, placeholder color, low-priority surface accents

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Card and section dividers, subtle borders on white surfaces, separators between review cards

palette.name: Bone
palette.role: Lightest card and list surface — sits one step above pure white for subtle elevation on the page canvas

palette.name: Paper
palette.role: Page canvas, card surfaces, button text, input fills. The dominant light surface
